question: Which of the following nations won the first T20 World Cup in 2007?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.**__​__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
